name: Zeus-Protocol
description: Self-contained personal wellness app — agenda, routines, supplements, tasks, calendar and biomarker tracking, plus Whoop/Apple Health integrations, in a single HTML file with Supabase-backed accounts.

paragraphs: ZEUS Protocol is a personal wellness tracker built as a single self-contained HTML file — no build step, no framework — served from GitHub Pages and added to the iPhone home screen as a web app.

Agenda merges routines, supplement blocks and calendar events into one timeline, with a live eating-window countdown. Routines support optional items you switch on per day, weekday scheduling and streak counters. Supplements are grouped into timed blocks with doses. Tasks track one-off and dated to-dos with overdue tracking, separate from the daily routine. Calendar subscribes to iCal feeds through a Cloudflare Worker proxy, with month, week and day views. Bio reads biomarkers from lab PDFs — including scanned reports with no text layer, via an in-browser OCR fallback (Tesseract.js) — and…

Accounts run on Supabase (hosted in the EU), with local-first sync: the app works fully offline from local storage and syncs on sign-in. A GDPR consent gate, privacy page and account-deletion flow are built in. Biomarker data never leaves the device — it stays in local storage only, whether or not you're signed in. A full JSON export/import covers backup and portability regardless of sign-in state. Each account can personalise which tabs are shown and rename the app to their own "'s Protocol".
